_comment: Example persona_assignments. Orchestrator generates this by clustering the filtered prospect list (typically 50 records) into 3-5 persona buckets based on title patterns + POV target_personas.

capital_projects_pmo.label: Capital Projects / PMO / Construction
capital_projects_pmo.prospect_pov: Director or senior PM tier currently coordinating concurrent megaprograms across continents. Each program has its own master schedule, FF&E lead times, contractor stack, pre-opening playbook — and one rollup that has to land cleanly every Tuesday standup and every earnings call.

engineering_facilities.label: Engineering & Facilities
engineering_facilities.prospect_pov: Director of Engineering or Facilities at a property in the middle of a portfolio refresh. Property engineering during a capital program is the receiving team — inheriting newly-built infrastructure on opening day, or running the existing property while the next tower gets built.

capital_fpa.label: Capital FP&A / Strategic Planning
capital_fpa.prospect_pov: Director or Manager of Capital FP&A currently building the rollup the new CFO needs for the quarterly call. Each program's capex variance, schedule, FF&E spend, and risk register lives in a different system.
